assets.name: grass
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: tileable diffuse albedo texture for a real 3D minigolf ground, 1024x1024 square. Create an orthographic directly overhead hand-painted gouache meadow surface, inspired by warm pastoral Studio Ghibli background paintings. Extremely subtle small brush strokes and short grass marks, natural sage green #789B65 with moss #526B48 and lighter olive patches, low contrast and flat even illumination, subdued muted hues. This is playable short turf: no large plants, no objects, no flowers, no borders, no checkerboard, no cast shadows, no perspective, no black or saturated lime areas, no text, no watermark. Edges should blend seamlessly when repeated. Soft broad organic color mottling with fine artisanal brush texture, painterly but calm so a small colored golf ball is easy to see.

assets.name: wood
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: tileable diffuse albedo texture for minigolf wooden borders and hand-crafted garden objects, 1024x1024 square. Create a hand-painted watercolor/gouache warm weathered cedar wood grain in the pastoral Studio Ghibli background-painting aesthetic. Full-frame wood with flowing delicate wavy lengthwise grain, soft irregular brush variation and a few tiny rounded knots; light honey brown #96724D and golden cream #D9B976, warm restrained colors and low contrast, flat even illumination. Organic aged surface, understated handcrafted charm, no photorealism, no hard dividing plank seams, no perspective, no lighting gradient, no cast shadows, no objects, no text, no watermark. All edges visually blend when tiled. Keep the grain readable but soft, suitable for a small 3D game.

mascots.source: Generated from the user's supplied illustration, preserving markings and composition; derived artwork, not a byte-for-byte original
mascots.mode: built-in image editing with one conversation reference
mascots.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: finished wide illustrated mascot header for the existing PitPom Minigolfe game. Input image 1 is the user's approved visual reference and composition. Produce a faithful game-ready illustration based on that reference; preserve the same two animals, their species, markings, face shapes, expressions, relative sizes, seated poses, placement, garden composition, warm painted watercolor/gouache storybook aesthetic and golden afternoon light. Identity correction: PITuca/Pit is the SHORT-HAIRED BLACK AND WHITE DOG at the right, with a mostly black head, floppy black ears, brown eyes, a narrow irregular white blaze, white speckled muzzle and chest, black shoulder/body patches, happy open mouth and pink tongue. POMPOM/Pom is the ORANGE AND WHITE CAT at the left, with orange tabby face patches, orange ears and tail, white muzzle/chest/legs and round olive-golden eyes. These names do not imply swapping species or positions. Preserve the large flowering tree at left, sage garden, cream daisies, mossy stones, mushrooms, winding aged wood mini-golf borders, blank wooden sign at right, distant lake/mountains/village, pastel blue sky and peach clouds. Horizontal 2:1 composition, approximately 1536x768 or matching the reference aspect ratio. Keep both animals' full faces and bodies clearly visible together in the center, leaving surrounding garden. No new animals, no altered dog fur length, no fluffy mostly-white dog, no added text or lettering, no names drawn in the image, no logo, no watermark. Opaque image.
